title: A novel electrified sorption enhanced reforming process for blue hydrogen production
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,624-638
DOI: 10.1039/D4YA00540F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abdelrahman Mostafa, Alessandra Beretta, Gianpiero Groppi, Enrico Tronconi, Matteo C. Romano
Electrified sorption enhanced reforming (eSER), a novel approach using electrified reactors for low-carbon H2 production, is proposed. Techno-economic analysis shows eSER's high efficiency and competitive costs compared to benchmark technologies.
